Purpose / failure mechanism: Verify regulation over the intended battery/input range and identify undervoltage lockout/overvoltage lockout boundaries
Typical stimulus / conditions: Sweep input slowly from below minimum to above maximum at light, nominal and full load; include the ISO 16750-2 §4.2 profile (1 V/s ramps with dwells at USmin/USmax, minimum temperature/room temperature/maximum temperature)
Measure / record: input voltage, input current, output voltage, output current, state/faults
Acceptance / target: Output and functions remain within product requirements throughout specified operating range
Equipment required: Keysight N6700 modular power system with N6775A source and N6791A electronic load; thermal chamber; optional precision digital multimeter; no separate electrical data logger required when N6700 measurements are streamed to the control computer
N6700 mapping with N6775A + N6791A: N6775A supplies the sweep; N6791A loads the output. N6700 readback plus computer logging normally replaces a separate electrical logger.
Main reference: ISO 16750-2:2023 §4.2 (supply-voltage codes A–D/Z for 12 V, E–H/Z for 24 V); product specification

Purpose / failure mechanism: Establish absolute output accuracy
Typical stimulus / conditions: Nominal input voltage; 0%, 10%, 50%, 100% load; hot/room/cold
Measure / record: output voltage mean, min/max
Acceptance / target: Within output-voltage tolerance
Equipment required: Keysight N6700 modular power system with N6775A source and N6791A electronic load; thermal chamber; precision digital multimeter recommended when tighter uncertainty or independent verification is required
N6700 mapping with N6775A + N6791A: N6775A supplies and N6791A loads/measures. Add a calibrated precision multimeter only when the uncertainty budget requires it.

Purpose / failure mechanism: Quantify output voltage sensitivity to input voltage
Typical stimulus / conditions: Sweep input voltage across operating range at fixed loads
Measure / record: output-voltage change versus input-voltage change; % line regulation
Acceptance / target: Within design requirement
Equipment required: Keysight N6700 modular power system with N6775A source and N6791A electronic load; precision digital multimeter recommended when tighter uncertainty or independent verification is required
N6700 mapping with N6775A + N6791A: N6775A sweeps input voltage; N6791A fixes load; N6700 readback and computer logging are sufficient for routine characterization.

Purpose / failure mechanism: Quantify output voltage sensitivity to load
Typical stimulus / conditions: Sweep load from minimum to full load at low/nominal/high input voltage
Measure / record: output voltage vs output current; % load regulation
Acceptance / target: Within design requirement
Equipment required: Keysight N6700 modular power system with N6775A source and N6791A electronic load; precision digital multimeter recommended when tighter uncertainty or independent verification is required
N6700 mapping with N6775A + N6791A: N6775A supplies; N6791A performs the load sweep and output measurement.

Purpose / failure mechanism: Establish efficiency, loss and thermal worst cases
Typical stimulus / conditions: Sweep input voltage × load × temperature
Measure / record: input power, output power, efficiency, case/component temperature
Acceptance / target: Meets efficiency and thermal budget; no thermal limit violation
Equipment required: Keysight N6700 modular power system with N6775A source and N6791A electronic load; thermal chamber; Accurate current/voltage measurement; power analyzer optional
N6700 mapping with N6775A + N6791A: Use N6775A input measurements and N6791A output measurements for the efficiency map; add a power analyzer for tighter uncertainty.

Purpose / failure mechanism: Verify key-off/standby consumption (quick bench check; formal closed-circuit current is AUTO-015) Cross-reference: SYS-003 covers the realistic closed-circuit-current case with bus activity.
Typical stimulus / conditions: No load and defined sleep/key-off states across input voltage and temperature
Measure / record: input current average, peak/wake events
Acceptance / target: Customer/vehicle-manufacturer current budget met
Equipment required: Keysight N6700 modular power system with N6775A source and N6791A electronic load; thermal chamber; microampere-capable ammeter or source-measure unit
N6700 mapping with N6775A + N6791A: N6775A supplies, but its 3-milliampere current resolution is unsuitable for microampere sleep current; add a low-current meter/source-measure unit.
Main reference: LV 124 E-19 Closed-circuit current; product requirement

Purpose / failure mechanism: Check switching ripple, burst/pulse-frequency modulation artifacts and broadband noise Cross-reference: Effective capacitance per PS-033 must be current before this result is used for ripple conclusions.
Typical stimulus / conditions: Minimum/nominal/maximum input voltage; light/nom/full load; hot/cold
Measure / record: output voltage ripple peak-to-peak/root-mean-square; dominant frequencies
Acceptance / target: Within rail/noise specification
Equipment required: Keysight N6700 modular power system with N6775A source and N6791A electronic load; digital oscilloscope; thermal chamber; Proper low-inductance probe or coax tip
N6700 mapping with N6775A + N6791A: N6700 provides source/load only; keep the external oscilloscope and low-inductance probing for ripple/noise.

Purpose / failure mechanism: Verify control-loop response to rapid load changes Cross-reference: Effective capacitance per PS-033 must be current before this result is used for transient or loop conclusions.
Typical stimulus / conditions: Load steps e.g. 10→90% and 90→10%; several slew rates
Measure / record: output voltage undershoot/overshoot, recovery time, ringing
Acceptance / target: No reset/protection; within transient-voltage requirement
Equipment required: Keysight N6700 modular power system with N6775A source and N6791A electronic load; digital oscilloscope; Electronic load with dynamic mode; current probe helpful
N6700 mapping with N6775A + N6791A: N6791A performs dynamic load steps within 60 volts, 20 amperes and 100 watts; use the oscilloscope for transient capture.

Purpose / failure mechanism: Verify immunity to rapid but non-destructive input changes
Typical stimulus / conditions: Step input voltage between representative low/nominal/high values
Measure / record: output voltage excursion, recovery time, state/faults
Acceptance / target: Meets regulation/recovery requirement
Equipment required: Keysight N6700 modular power system with N6775A source and N6791A electronic load; digital oscilloscope; Source with adequate slew/bandwidth
N6700 mapping with N6775A + N6791A: N6775A can screen positive line steps; use a four-quadrant simulator/amplifier when required source/sink dynamics exceed it.

Purpose / failure mechanism: Verify monotonic startup, soft-start and sequencing
Typical stimulus / conditions: Power-on at multiple input voltage/load/temp combinations; enable-pin startup if present
Measure / record: Inrush, rise time, overshoot, sequencing, power-good
Acceptance / target: No excessive overshoot; correct sequencing and timing
Equipment required: Keysight N6700 modular power system with N6775A source and N6791A electronic load; digital oscilloscope; Current probe useful
N6700 mapping with N6775A + N6791A: N6775A performs turn-on and N6791A sets load; use oscilloscope/current probe for fast inrush and sequencing.

Purpose / failure mechanism: Check controlled turn-off and reverse current
Typical stimulus / conditions: Disable/power removal at different loads and input voltage
Measure / record: Fall time, negative voltage, backfeed, fault state
Acceptance / target: Safe monotonic shutdown; no damaging reverse current
Equipment required: Keysight N6700 modular power system with N6775A source and N6791A electronic load; digital oscilloscope; Current probe useful
N6700 mapping with N6775A + N6791A: N6775A removes input and N6791A holds load; reverse-current cases need a second source-capable instrument.

Purpose / failure mechanism: Verify input capacitor charging and switch/FET stress
Typical stimulus / conditions: Repeated hot-plug or programmed fast input voltage edges at cold/room/hot
Measure / record: Peak current, charge, current-squared-time stress, input voltage dip
Acceptance / target: Connector/fuse/FET/cap limits not exceeded
Equipment required: Keysight N6700 modular power system with N6775A source and N6791A electronic load; digital oscilloscope; thermal chamber; Current probe/shunt with suitable bandwidth
N6700 mapping with N6775A + N6791A: N6775A supplies; use external wide-band current measurement and a representative hot-plug switch/cable for peak inrush.
Main reference: Keysight DC-DC Converter Testing Fundamentals; product/vehicle-manufacturer requirement

Purpose / failure mechanism: Verify deterministic recovery from undervoltage lockout/overload/fault
Typical stimulus / conditions: Repeated enable cycles and fault-clear cycles
Measure / record: Restart period, peak current, output voltage overshoot
Acceptance / target: No latch-up or uncontrolled repeated stress; restart behavior matches the technical safety concept (latched, counter-limited retry or automatic retry)
Equipment required: Keysight N6700 modular power system with N6775A source and N6791A electronic load; digital oscilloscope
N6700 mapping with N6775A + N6791A: Automate N6775A/N6791A cycles over Standard Commands for Programmable Instruments; stream measurements to the control computer.

Purpose / failure mechanism: Verify current-limit threshold and thermal behavior
Typical stimulus / conditions: Increase load beyond rated output; test hot/cold and input voltage corners
Measure / record: Limit current, output voltage, temperature, mode
Acceptance / target: Threshold inside specified band; no damage
Equipment required: Keysight N6700 modular power system with N6775A source and N6791A electronic load; digital oscilloscope; thermal chamber
N6700 mapping with N6775A + N6791A: N6791A can apply overload only within its 20-ampere and 100-watt envelope.
Main reference: ISO 16750-2:2023 §4.10.3; LV 124 E-22 Overcurrents; product requirement

Purpose / failure mechanism: Verify short-circuit withstand and recovery
Typical stimulus / conditions: Short output while off and while operating; controlled duration
Measure / record: output current peak/steady, input current, temperatures, recovery
Acceptance / target: No fire/damage; recovery matches requirement
Equipment required: Keysight N6700 modular power system with N6775A source and N6791A electronic load; digital oscilloscope; Low-ohmic high-current short fixture / relay recommended
N6700 mapping with N6775A + N6791A: N6791A is not a hard short; use an external low-resistance short-circuit fixture while N6775A powers the converter.
Main reference: ISO 16750-2:2023 §4.10.2; LV 124 E-17 / E-22; product requirement

Purpose / failure mechanism: Verify overvoltage protection threshold and safe state
Typical stimulus / conditions: Force feedback fault where safely possible or inject external output voltage
Measure / record: Trip threshold, response time, latch/recovery
Acceptance / target: No downstream overvoltage beyond allowed limit
Equipment required: Keysight N6700 modular power system with N6775A source and N6791A electronic load; digital oscilloscope; Fault-injection fixture; external source may be needed
N6700 mapping with N6775A + N6791A: N6700 can power/load normally; forced-output overvoltage needs a second source/source-measure unit and fault-injection fixture.

Purpose / failure mechanism: Check behavior when output is externally driven while input is absent or lower (run together with AUTO-016)
Typical stimulus / conditions: Apply allowed external output voltage; vary input voltage/enable state
Measure / record: Reverse current into output/input; internal heating
Acceptance / target: Within backfeed/reverse-current requirement
Equipment required: Keysight N6700 modular power system with N6775A source and N6791A electronic load; digital oscilloscope; Source-capable load or second DC source
N6700 mapping with N6775A + N6791A: N6791A cannot source the output; add a second source/source-measure unit for backfeed testing.

Purpose / failure mechanism: Verify survival under battery reversal where applicable
Typical stimulus / conditions: Apply specified negative input voltage/current limit
Measure / record: Input current, component stress, post-test function
Acceptance / target: Required functional status and no unsafe damage
Equipment required: Keysight N6700 modular power system with N6775A source and N6791A electronic load; digital oscilloscope; Polarity-swap contactor/fixture with adequate source current limit or fuse; bipolar/4-quadrant source only for dynamic reversal
N6700 mapping with N6775A + N6791A: N6775A cannot generate negative voltage; static reversal needs a polarity-swap fixture, dynamic reversal a bipolar/four-quadrant source.

Purpose / failure mechanism: Early bench screen of intermittent connector/battery contact before formal AUTO-010, AUTO-013 and AUTO-014
Typical stimulus / conditions: Open supply for controlled durations, including repeated interruptions
Measure / record: output voltage hold-up, reset point, recovery, diagnostic trouble codes
Acceptance / target: Defined reset/recovery; no undefined state
Equipment required: Keysight N6700 modular power system with N6775A source and N6791A electronic load; digital oscilloscope; Fast relay/MOSFET interruption fixture for sub-ms work
N6700 mapping with N6775A + N6791A: N6775A supplies steady input; fast interruptions need an external transistor/relay fault-insertion unit and oscilloscope verification.

Purpose / failure mechanism: Verify tolerance to differences between device under test ground and system ground
Typical stimulus / conditions: Insert programmable/specified offset or resistance in return path
Measure / record: output voltage, communications, currents, diagnostic trouble codes
Acceptance / target: Meets functional requirement without unsafe current
Equipment required: Keysight N6700 modular power system with N6775A source and N6791A electronic load; digital oscilloscope; Floating/bipolar source or offset injection fixture
N6700 mapping with N6775A + N6791A: N6700 provides normal source/load only; controlled ground offset needs a dedicated offset-injection fixture or floating source.

Purpose / failure mechanism: Confirm phase/gain margin and crossover at all corners; a marginal loop can pass a single load-step test and still oscillate with tolerance, ageing or temperature Cross-reference: Where the control loop is not accessible, execute PS-032 instead; where it is accessible, run both and compare.
Typical stimulus / conditions: Loop injection (injection resistor + transformer) at input voltage minimum/nominal/maximum × load minimum/nominal/maximum × minimum temperature/room temperature/maximum temperature, with min and max effective output capacitance
Measure / record: Crossover frequency, phase margin, gain margin
Acceptance / target: Per design rule (commonly phase margin ≥ 45°, gain margin ≥ 6–10 dB) at every corner
Equipment required: Keysight N6700 modular power system with N6775A source and N6791A electronic load; digital oscilloscope; thermal chamber; Frequency-response analyzer or scope frequency-response analysis option; injection transformer; injection-resistor footprint on the PCB
N6700 mapping with N6775A + N6791A: N6700 sets operating point; loop gain needs frequency-response analysis, injection transformer and injection-resistor test point.
Main reference: Middlebrook voltage-injection method; product design rules

Purpose / failure mechanism: Quantify how input ripple and load-current noise reach the output; explains AUTO-006 and PS-008 results
Typical stimulus / conditions: Small-signal injection on input (line injector) and output (current injector), swept roughly 10 Hz–1 MHz at representative input voltage/load
Measure / record: PSRR(f), Zout(f), resonance peaks
Acceptance / target: No resonance peak that violates the rail noise/transient budget
Equipment required: Keysight N6700 modular power system with N6775A source and N6791A electronic load; digital oscilloscope; frequency-response analysis plus line injector and current injector
N6700 mapping with N6775A + N6791A: N6700 sets operating point; power-supply-rejection/output-impedance sweeps need frequency-response analysis and injection hardware.

Purpose / failure mechanism: A regulated converter has negative incremental input resistance and can oscillate with its electromagnetic-interference filter plus harness/source impedance Cross-reference: PS-032 also applies because the minor-loop-gain basis covers input-filter interaction.
Typical stimulus / conditions: Low input voltage + full load through a representative harness and through a CISPR 25 artificial network; step load and input voltage
Measure / record: input voltage/input current oscillation, filter resonance, output voltage disturbance
Acceptance / target: No sustained oscillation; filter output impedance well below converter input impedance
Equipment required: Keysight N6700 modular power system with N6775A source and N6791A electronic load; digital oscilloscope; Representative harness/cable set; frequency-response analysis optional for impedance plots
N6700 mapping with N6775A + N6791A: N6700 sets operating point; representative harness/artificial-network impedance is required; frequency-response analysis is recommended.

Purpose / failure mechanism: Ceramic input capacitors plus harness inductance form an under-damped LC; hot-plugging can ring to about twice the step voltage and exceed FET/controller abs-max
Typical stimulus / conditions: Connect device under test to an already energized source via representative cable and mechanical relay; repeat at max operating input voltage and jump-start level; do this before PS-012
Measure / record: Peak input voltage at device under test pins, ringing frequency, damping
Acceptance / target: Peak below abs-max ratings with derating margin
Equipment required: Keysight N6700 modular power system with N6775A source and N6791A electronic load; digital oscilloscope; Mechanical relay/contactor; representative cable; short-ground probing
N6700 mapping with N6775A + N6791A: N6775A can energize the source, but hot plug requires representative cable and relay/contactor; capture at device pins with the oscilloscope.

Test: Switching frequency, spread spectrum and pulse-skipping map
Purpose / failure mechanism: switching frequency can move into protected radio bands (e.g. AM broadcast) at minimum on-time, in dropout or in pulse-frequency modulation; spread spectrum may be inactive in some modes
Typical stimulus / conditions: Sweep input voltage × load × temperature, including high input voltage/light load and low input voltage/full load
Measure / record: switching frequency min/max, dither range and rate, pulse skipping, subharmonic oscillation
Acceptance / target: Switching frequency and operating modes remain inside the product-defined envelope; no subharmonic oscillation; correlate the fundamental, harmonics and spread-spectrum behavior with electromagnetic-emissions pre-compliance results
Equipment required: Keysight N6700 modular power system with N6775A source and N6791A electronic load; digital oscilloscope; thermal chamber; Digital oscilloscope with fast-Fourier-transform analysis and long memory; near-field probe helpful
N6700 mapping with N6775A + N6791A: N6775A/N6791A sweep input/load; use oscilloscope fast-Fourier-transform analysis or spectrum analyzer to map switching modes.

Purpose / failure mechanism: Define behaviour when input voltage approaches output voltage (cranking, near-dead battery): maximum duty, frequency foldback, bypass mode
Typical stimulus / conditions: Slow ramp of input voltage down to undervoltage lockout and back at light/nominal/full load, hot and cold
Measure / record: output voltage vs input voltage, dropout voltage, switching frequency, ripple, mode transitions
Acceptance / target: output voltage within specification down to the specified minimum input voltage; smooth, repeatable transitions
Equipment required: Keysight N6700 modular power system with N6775A source and N6791A electronic load; thermal chamber
N6700 mapping with N6775A + N6791A: N6775A performs the slow input ramp and N6791A holds load; fully suitable within module ratings.

Test: Start-up into pre-bias and capacitive load
Purpose / failure mechanism: Synchronous converters can sink current from a pre-biased rail; large downstream bulk capacitance can trigger current limit or hiccup
Typical stimulus / conditions: Pre-bias output (0–90 % of output voltage) from an external source; start with min…max load capacitance, CR and constant-current load modes, hot and cold
Measure / record: Reverse current, monotonicity, start time, hiccup/fault events
Acceptance / target: Monotonic start; no reverse current beyond limit; starts with max capacitance at full load
Equipment required: Keysight N6700 modular power system with N6775A source and N6791A electronic load; digital oscilloscope; thermal chamber; Second source or diode/resistor network; capacitor bank
N6700 mapping with N6775A + N6791A: N6700 provides normal input/load; pre-bias needs an independent second source or equivalent network plus the required capacitor bank.

Purpose / failure mechanism: Thresholds, hysteresis and deglitch define ECU wake/reset behaviour; enable pins wired to battery must survive supply-level stress
Typical stimulus / conditions: Sweep and step EN/INH/wake; brown-out around power-good thresholds; apply the relevant supply tests to battery-connected control pins
Measure / record: EN thresholds/hysteresis, power-good/RESET thresholds and delays, glitch response
Acceptance / target: Within specification; no false wake or reset; control pins survive applicable tests
Equipment required: Keysight N6700 modular power system with N6775A source and N6791A electronic load; digital oscilloscope; Function generator
N6700 mapping with N6775A + N6791A: N6700 supplies/loads the converter; enable/wake thresholds and glitches need a separate function/arbitrary-waveform generator.
Main reference: Product requirement; ISO 16750-2:2023 (tests apply to all relevant inputs)

Purpose / failure mechanism: Most power-stage field failures are over-stress; semiconductors, capacitors and magnetics must stay inside derating limits at worst case, including transients Cross-reference: QUAL-001 establishes that the components are qualified for the location; derating alone does not.
Typical stimulus / conditions: Worst-case corners: max input voltage + load step, start-up, short-circuit entry/exit, jump start, hot; capture during protection and AUTO tests
Measure / record: MOSFET Vds peak and ringing, diode reverse voltage, gate-drive levels, inductor peak current/saturation, capacitor ripple current and temperature
Acceptance / target: All stresses within derated datasheet limits
Equipment required: Keysight N6700 modular power system with N6775A source and N6791A electronic load; digital oscilloscope; thermal chamber; High-bandwidth voltage probes, current probe, thermocouples/infrared camera
N6700 mapping with N6775A + N6791A: N6700 generates corners; component-stress verification still needs high-bandwidth voltage/current probes and temperature sensors.

Purpose / failure mechanism: Output lines leaving the module can be shorted to KL30 during assembly or service
Typical stimulus / conditions: Short each output to battery voltage (max operating and jump-start level) and to GND, with device under test off and operating
Measure / record: Reverse current, internal heating, protection response, recovery
Acceptance / target: No damage; recovery and functional status per requirement
Equipment required: Keysight N6700 modular power system with N6775A source and N6791A electronic load; digital oscilloscope; Second high-current source, relay
N6700 mapping with N6775A + N6791A: A second independent current-capable source is required to short the output to battery while N6775A powers the input.

Purpose / failure mechanism: Each rail of a multi-output converter must regulate under all load combinations; sequencing/tracking must hold at all input voltage corners
Typical stimulus / conditions: Load matrix across outputs; power-up/power-down at input voltage and temperature corners
Measure / record: output voltage of each rail, sequence timing, tracking error
Acceptance / target: All rails within tolerance for all load combinations; correct sequence
Equipment required: Keysight N6700 modular power system with N6775A source and N6791A electronic load; thermal chamber; Multi-channel electronic load
N6700 mapping with N6775A + N6791A: One N6791A gives one load channel; multi-output cross-regulation needs additional independent load channels or load banks.

Test: Non-invasive stability margin from output impedance
Purpose / failure mechanism: Sealed PMICs, LDOs and multi-loop converters expose no injection point, so PS-021 cannot be executed at all; a marginal loop still passes a single load step. Output-impedance peaking yields phase margin without breaking the loop, and the minor-loop-gain basis makes the same measurement applicable to input-filter interaction
Typical stimulus / conditions: Small-signal current modulation at the output, swept approximately 100 Hz–10 MHz, at input voltage min/nom/max × load min/nom/max × Tmin/RT/Tmax, with minimum and maximum effective output capacitance
Measure / record: Zout(f) magnitude and phase, resonant peak frequency and Q, derived phase margin
Acceptance / target: Derived phase margin meets the design rule at every corner; no Zout resonance violating the rail noise/transient budget. The method saturates near 65–70°, so report ">70°" above that rather than a number
Equipment required: Keysight N6700 with N6775A and N6791A; thermal chamber; VNA/frequency-response analyzer with non-invasive stability capability; current injector; low-inductance 1:1 probing
N6700 mapping with N6775A + N6791A: N6700 sets the operating point. N6791A dynamic mode is not a calibrated small-signal injector; a VNA/frequency-response analyzer plus current injector is required
Main reference: OMICRON Lab Bode 100 output-impedance and non-invasive-stability application notes; Picotest NISM documentation; complements PS-021 and PS-023

Test: Effective capacitance under DC bias, temperature and ageing
Purpose / failure mechanism: Class-II multilayer ceramic capacitor loses a large fraction of rated capacitance under DC bias and at temperature extremes. The derated value moves the PS-021 crossover, the PS-007 ripple and the PS-008 transient envelope, yet is rarely re-measured after a BOM or supplier change
Typical stimulus / conditions: Measure input and output capacitor effective capacitance in-circuit or on coupons at 0 V and at the actual applied DC bias, across Tmin/RT/Tmax; repeat after endurance stress
Measure / record: Effective C vs DC bias and temperature; ESR over frequency; deviation from datasheet nominal; post-stress drift
Acceptance / target: Effective capacitance at worst-case bias and temperature stays inside the range assumed by the loop-compensation and ripple analyses
Equipment required: LCR meter or VNA with DC-bias capability; impedance adapters; thermal chamber
N6700 mapping with N6775A + N6791A: N6700 can supply the DC bias in some fixtures but cannot measure capacitance; an LCR meter or impedance-capable VNA is required
Main reference: Capacitor manufacturer bias/temperature characteristics; AEC-Q200 Rev E; feeds PS-007, PS-008 and PS-021

Test: Audible noise from capacitors and magnetics
Purpose / failure mechanism: Class-II multilayer ceramic capacitor piezoelectric singing and magnetics noise are common late-stage NVH rejections. They appear specifically in the pulse-skipping, burst and light-load modes that PS-025 maps, and only in the final mechanical assembly
Typical stimulus / conditions: Sweep input voltage × load × temperature including the light-load and dropout modes identified in PS-025; measure in a quiet enclosure at a defined distance, with the final mechanical assembly and mounting
Measure / record: Sound pressure level vs frequency; correlation with switching-mode transitions; tonality
Acceptance / target: Within the project NVH requirement across all operating modes; no tonal component in any mode reachable during normal vehicle operation
Equipment required: Measurement microphone and analyser; anechoic or low-noise enclosure; final mechanical assembly
N6700 mapping with N6775A + N6791A: N6700 sweeps the operating point; acoustic measurement needs its own instrumentation and a quiet environment. Chamber and load cooling fans preclude in-chamber measurement
Main reference: Project NVH requirement; capacitor manufacturer application notes; correlates with PS-025

Purpose / failure mechanism: Simulate charging/generator-control fault
Typical stimulus / conditions: Apply vehicle-manufacturer-defined elevated DC voltage for the required duration, typically at elevated temperature; ISO 16750-2 reference case: 18 V (12 V system) / 36 V (24 V system) for 60 min at maximum temperature − 20 °C
Measure / record: Input/output currents, output voltage, component temperature, function
Acceptance / target: Functional status per vehicle-manufacturer; no overstress/damage
Equipment required: Keysight N6700 modular power system with N6775A source and N6791A electronic load; digital oscilloscope; thermal chamber
N6700 mapping with N6775A + N6791A: N6775A generates the overvoltage profile within 60 volts, 5 amperes and 300 watts; N6791A loads the output.

Purpose / failure mechanism: Verify immunity to short high-voltage supply excursion
Typical stimulus / conditions: Program specified pulse when source bandwidth permits; ISO 16750-2 reference case (12 V): 18 V for 400 ms, 1 ms edges, 5 pulses (24 V: 36 V, 2 ms edges)
Measure / record: output voltage, reset/faults, peak device stress
Acceptance / target: Functional status per requirement
Equipment required: Keysight N6700 modular power system with N6775A source and N6791A electronic load; digital oscilloscope; Fast source/amplifier may be needed
N6700 mapping with N6775A + N6791A: N6775A can bench-screen overvoltage steps; formal 1–2 millisecond edges need a sufficiently fast simulator/amplifier.

Purpose / failure mechanism: Verify operation through temporary battery sag
Typical stimulus / conditions: Apply specified low-voltage level and duration
Measure / record: output voltage, reset threshold, hold-up/recovery
Acceptance / target: No undefined behavior; status per requirement
Equipment required: Keysight N6700 modular power system with N6775A source and N6791A electronic load; digital oscilloscope
N6700 mapping with N6775A + N6791A: N6775A generates undervoltage levels/dwells; verify edge timing and add a faster switch/simulator if needed.

Purpose / failure mechanism: Verify survival of elevated battery voltage during jump starting
Typical stimulus / conditions: Apply specified jump-start level/duration (ISO 16750-2:2023 defines it for 12 V systems only: 26 V for 60 s, edges ≤ 10 ms, at room temperature and minimum temperature)
Measure / record: output voltage, input current, temperature, post-test function
Acceptance / target: No damage; function/status per vehicle-manufacturer
Present setup: Available if within N6775A voltage/current/power limits
Equipment required: Keysight N6700 modular power system with N6775A source and N6791A electronic load; digital oscilloscope; thermal chamber; Higher-voltage source if bench source range is insufficient
N6700 mapping with N6775A + N6791A: The 26-volt 12-volt-system jump-start level is within N6775A range, subject to 5-ampere/300-watt limits.

Purpose / failure mechanism: Verify immunity to the energy-rich transient that occurs when the battery disconnects while the alternator is charging
Typical stimulus / conditions: Apply specified load-dump pulse and source impedance: ISO 16750-2 Test A (unsuppressed) or Test B (centrally clamped); LV 124 E-05 is a clamped trapezoid (27 V, 300 ms, ≤ 2 ms rise in the 2013 edition)
Measure / record: Clamp voltage/current, absorbed energy, output voltage, survival
Acceptance / target: No unsafe damage; functional status per requirement
Equipment required: Keysight N6700 modular power system with N6775A source and N6791A electronic load; digital oscilloscope; LV 124 E-05 / clamped profiles: fast 4-quadrant amplifier or battery simulator. ISO 16750-2 Test A/B: load-dump generator with defined Ri, verified per ISO 16750-2 Annex A
N6700 mapping with N6775A + N6791A: N6775A is not a load-dump generator; formal testing needs a compliant load-dump generator or suitable fast four-quadrant amplifier/simulator.
Main reference: ISO 16750-2:2023 §4.6.4 + Annex A; LV 124 E-05. ISO 7637-2:2011 is background only — pulses 5a/5b were removed from it in 2011

Purpose / failure mechanism: Check susceptibility to AC ripple on battery rail Cross-reference: This overlaps EMC-009 in frequency but is a different test with different coupling and severity; execute both where the customer cites both.
Typical stimulus / conditions: Sweep sinusoidal/defined AC ripple on DC input over specified frequency/amplitude (ISO 16750-2:2023 extends the range to 200 kHz)
Measure / record: output voltage ripple transfer, resets, faults, input current
Acceptance / target: Functional status A where required; no abnormal oscillation
Equipment required: Keysight N6700 modular power system with N6775A source and N6791A electronic load; digital oscilloscope; Power amplifier/4-quadrant supply or coupling transformer for the full range (up to 200 kHz)
N6700 mapping with N6775A + N6791A: N6775A cannot cover superimposed alternating voltage through 200 kilohertz; add a suitable high-bandwidth amplifier/coupling arrangement.

Purpose / failure mechanism: Simulate battery discharge/charge and determine reset thresholds
Typical stimulus / conditions: Slowly ramp from upper operating voltage toward 0 V and back
Measure / record: Reset/off/on thresholds, hysteresis, diagnostic trouble codes, output voltage
Acceptance / target: Defined behavior; no unstable reset cycling
Equipment required: Keysight N6700 modular power system with N6775A source and N6791A electronic load; digital oscilloscope
N6700 mapping with N6775A + N6791A: N6775A is well suited to the slow decrease/increase profile; N6791A loads and N6700 logs.

Purpose / failure mechanism: Verify recovery after near-dead battery followed by rapid restoration
Typical stimulus / conditions: Slow ramp down followed by abrupt return
Measure / record: Reset/recovery time, inrush, overshoot
Acceptance / target: Deterministic recovery; no latch-up
Equipment required: Keysight N6700 modular power system with N6775A source and N6791A electronic load; digital oscilloscope
N6700 mapping with N6775A + N6791A: N6775A performs the slow decrease; verify fast-rise timing and add a faster simulator/switching stage if required.

Purpose / failure mechanism: Characterize functional boundary around reset voltage
Typical stimulus / conditions: Sweep/dwell around undervoltage lockout and reset threshold under several loads/temps
Measure / record: Reset threshold, hysteresis, boot time, memory/diagnostic trouble code status
Acceptance / target: Repeatable thresholds; no corrupt state/nonvolatile memory
Equipment required: Keysight N6700 modular power system with N6775A source and N6791A electronic load; digital oscilloscope; device-under-test communications interface; control computer for logging
N6700 mapping with N6775A + N6791A: N6775A performs threshold sweeps/dwells; N6791A holds load; use oscilloscope/computer logging for reset timing.

Purpose / failure mechanism: Verify hold-up for contact bounce / micro-interruptions
Typical stimulus / conditions: Interrupt input voltage for specified durations from µs/ms upward
Measure / record: Minimum input voltage, output voltage droop, reset/no-reset boundary
Acceptance / target: Required functional status; deterministic recovery
Equipment required: Keysight N6700 modular power system with N6775A source and N6791A electronic load; digital oscilloscope; Fast MOSFET/relay interruption fixture for short durations
N6700 mapping with N6775A + N6791A: N6775A supplies steady input; micro-interruptions need a fast external interrupter or compliant simulator.

Purpose / failure mechanism: Simulate starter-motor battery sag and recovery profile
Typical stimulus / conditions: Reproduce vehicle-manufacturer-defined cranking waveform at cold and warm conditions
Measure / record: output voltage, reset, current, boot time, control-state continuity
Acceptance / target: Start-relevant functions meet required status
Equipment required: Keysight N6700 modular power system with N6775A source and N6791A electronic load; digital oscilloscope; thermal chamber; Arbitrary source/4-quadrant amplifier if bench programmable power supply cannot reproduce waveform
N6700 mapping with N6775A + N6791A: N6775A can reproduce some crank profiles within ratings; formal use requires waveform verification and may need a four-quadrant simulator.

Purpose / failure mechanism: Verify operation under dynamic alternator control
Typical stimulus / conditions: Replay defined battery-voltage profile
Measure / record: output voltage, input current, mode transitions, faults
Acceptance / target: Required functional status
Equipment required: Keysight N6700 modular power system with N6775A source and N6791A electronic load; digital oscilloscope; Arbitrary waveform-capable supply recommended
N6700 mapping with N6775A + N6791A: N6775A can replay positive smart-charging profiles within its voltage/current/power and dynamic limits.

Purpose / failure mechanism: Detect sensitivity to intermittent individual power/ground pins
Typical stimulus / conditions: Open one supply/ground pin at a time if multiple pins exist; include loss of ground with I/O still connected; static and dynamic (burst) interruption
Measure / record: Pin currents, output voltage, thermal imbalance, diagnostic trouble codes
Acceptance / target: No connector/pin overstress; defined function
Equipment required: Keysight N6700 modular power system with N6775A source and N6791A electronic load; digital oscilloscope; Multi-pole relay matrix / fault-insertion unit
N6700 mapping with N6775A + N6791A: N6700 provides source/load; individual pin interruptions need a multi-pole relay/fault-insertion matrix.

Purpose / failure mechanism: Simulate complete connector disconnect/reconnect
Typical stimulus / conditions: Open/reconnect supply and relevant signals under defined state
Measure / record: Inrush, reset/recovery, arcing-related behavior
Acceptance / target: Defined recovery; no damage
Equipment required: Keysight N6700 modular power system with N6775A source and N6791A electronic load; digital oscilloscope; Automotive relay/fault insertion fixture
N6700 mapping with N6775A + N6791A: N6700 provides source/load; connector interruption/reconnect needs an automotive relay/contactor or connector fault fixture.

Purpose / failure mechanism: Verify sleep current over voltage and temperature (formal measurement; PS-006 is the quick bench check) Cross-reference: SYS-003 covers the realistic closed-circuit-current case with bus activity.
Typical stimulus / conditions: Measure long-term current after all timers expire
Measure / record: Sleep current, periodic wakeups, energy/day
Acceptance / target: vehicle-manufacturer current budget met
Equipment required: Keysight N6700 modular power system with N6775A source and N6791A electronic load; digital oscilloscope; high-dynamic-range ammeter or source-measure unit; control computer for logging
N6700 mapping with N6775A + N6791A: N6775A supplies, but its 3-milliampere current resolution is unsuitable for microampere closed-circuit-current limits; add a low-current instrument.

Purpose / failure mechanism: Ensure output or I/O does not unintentionally power the ECU/vehicle rail (run together with PS-017)
Typical stimulus / conditions: Remove input voltage and energize output/I/O paths as applicable
Measure / record: Reverse current and unintended rail voltage
Acceptance / target: Below allowed backfeed limits
Equipment required: Keysight N6700 modular power system with N6775A source and N6791A electronic load; digital oscilloscope; Additional source(s), ammeters
N6700 mapping with N6775A + N6791A: Backfeed requires an independent source on the output or signal path; N6791A cannot source power.

Purpose / failure mechanism: Find wear-out and marginal restart behavior
Typical stimulus / conditions: Thousands to millions of controlled power cycles; combine with hot/cold as needed
Measure / record: Failures, drift, inrush distribution, boot time
Acceptance / target: No unacceptable drift/failure over required cycles
Equipment required: Keysight N6700 modular power system with N6775A source and N6791A electronic load; digital oscilloscope; thermal chamber; automated relay or transistor switching; control computer for continuous logging
N6700 mapping with N6775A + N6791A: Automate N6775A output switching and N6791A loading; stream data continuously and retain independent safety cutoffs.
Main reference: LV 124 (2021) E-24 ON/OFF duration test; vehicle-manufacturer endurance requirement; product DV plan

Purpose / failure mechanism: devices under test with two or more supply inputs (e.g. KL30 + KL30B, redundant feeds) can pass current between feeds or power a switched feed Cross-reference: For dual independently powered nets see BI-002.
Typical stimulus / conditions: Apply voltage differences between supply inputs, including one input open or at 0 V
Measure / record: Current between inputs, voltage on the unpowered feed
Acceptance / target: Within allowed equalizing current; no unintended powering of switched feeds
Equipment required: Keysight N6700 modular power system with N6775A source and N6791A electronic load; digital oscilloscope; Second source, ammeters
N6700 mapping with N6775A + N6791A: Multiple independent supply inputs require another source in addition to N6775A plus current measurement.

Purpose / failure mechanism: Detect insulation weakness between galvanically separated circuits, or circuits and housing, especially after humidity stress Cross-reference: A dielectric-withstand pass does not exclude partial discharge; see HV-003 for isolated barriers.
Typical stimulus / conditions: Apply the specified DC test voltage between isolated parts; repeat after damp heat
Measure / record: Insulation resistance
Acceptance / target: At or above the specified minimum
Equipment required: Keysight N6700 modular power system with N6775A source and N6791A electronic load; digital oscilloscope; Insulation resistance tester
N6700 mapping with N6775A + N6791A: N6700 cannot measure insulation resistance; use a dedicated insulation-resistance tester.

Purpose / failure mechanism: Verify that isolation barriers and clearances do not break down Cross-reference: A dielectric-withstand pass does not exclude partial discharge; see HV-003 for isolated barriers.
Typical stimulus / conditions: Apply the specified test voltage between isolated circuits and housing, where the specification requires it
Measure / record: Breakdown/flashover, leakage current
Acceptance / target: No breakdown or flashover
Equipment required: Keysight N6700 modular power system with N6775A source and N6791A electronic load; digital oscilloscope; Hipot tester and safety enclosure
N6700 mapping with N6775A + N6791A: N6700 cannot perform dielectric withstand testing; use a compliant hipot tester with safety interlocks.

Purpose / failure mechanism: Simulate negative transient caused by interruption of inductive loads sharing the supply Cross-reference: Generator verification per TR-008 is a precondition for inter-laboratory comparability.
Typical stimulus / conditions: Standardized pulse applied to supply line
Measure / record: device under test function, output voltage, clamp current/voltage
Acceptance / target: Functional performance status per test plan
Equipment required: Keysight N6700 modular power system with N6775A source and N6791A electronic load; digital oscilloscope; ISO 7637-2 transient generator/coupling network
N6700 mapping with N6775A + N6791A: N6700 may provide operating bias/load; the pulse requires a compliant ISO 7637-2 generator and coupling network.

Purpose / failure mechanism: Simulate positive transient when current through a device in parallel with the device under test is suddenly interrupted and the harness inductance releases its energy Cross-reference: Generator verification per TR-008 is a precondition for inter-laboratory comparability.
Typical stimulus / conditions: Standardized positive pulse
Measure / record: device under test function and stress
Acceptance / target: Status per test plan
Equipment required: Keysight N6700 modular power system with N6775A source and N6791A electronic load; digital oscilloscope; ISO 7637-2 transient generator
N6700 mapping with N6775A + N6791A: N6700 may provide operating bias/load; the pulse requires a compliant ISO 7637-2 generator and coupling network.

Purpose / failure mechanism: Simulate supply transient related to DC motor acting as a generator after ignition-off Cross-reference: Generator verification per TR-008 is a precondition for inter-laboratory comparability.
Typical stimulus / conditions: Standardized pulse/profile
Measure / record: device under test function/restart
Acceptance / target: Status per test plan
Equipment required: Keysight N6700 modular power system with N6775A source and N6791A electronic load; digital oscilloscope; Automotive transient generator / arbitrary source
N6700 mapping with N6775A + N6791A: N6775A is not a compliant pulse-2b generator; add an automotive transient generator or verified simulator.

Purpose / failure mechanism: Simulate fast switching/contact-bounce transients Cross-reference: Generator verification per TR-008 is a precondition for inter-laboratory comparability.
Typical stimulus / conditions: Fast negative and positive burst pulses
Measure / record: Functional upset, resets, latent damage
Acceptance / target: Functional performance status per test plan
Equipment required: Keysight N6700 modular power system with N6775A source and N6791A electronic load; digital oscilloscope; Fast transient generator and coupling network
N6700 mapping with N6775A + N6791A: N6775A cannot generate pulse-3a/3b bursts; add a compliant fast-transient generator/coupling network.

Purpose / failure mechanism: Verify immunity of enable/communication/sense lines to coupled switching transients
Typical stimulus / conditions: CCC/DCC/ICC coupling methods on non-supply lines
Measure / record: Functional state, communications errors, resets
Acceptance / target: functional performance status classification per plan
Equipment required: Keysight N6700 modular power system with N6775A source and N6791A electronic load; digital oscilloscope; CCC/DCC/ICC coupling fixtures and generator
N6700 mapping with N6775A + N6791A: N6700 powers/loads the device; ISO 7637-3 coupling needs the specified generator and coupling fixtures.

Test: Transients generated by the device under test
Purpose / failure mechanism: Switching the device under test and its loads on/off injects transients into the vehicle supply that can upset other ECUs Cross-reference: Generator verification per TR-008 is a precondition for inter-laboratory comparability.
Typical stimulus / conditions: Measure supply-line transients with artificial network and the defined switch while switching the device under test, per ISO 7637-2
Measure / record: Peak amplitude, duration, rise/fall time of emitted transients
Acceptance / target: Within vehicle-manufacturer transient-emission limits
Equipment required: Keysight N6700 modular power system with N6775A source and N6791A electronic load; digital oscilloscope; Artificial network, switch per standard, high-voltage probe (digital oscilloscope already available)
N6700 mapping with N6775A + N6791A: N6700 powers/loads the device; transient-emission measurement needs the specified artificial network, switch and high-voltage probing.

Test: HV shielded-line conducted transients (injection and measurement)
Purpose / failure mechanism: Equipment on isolated supplies above 60 V DC sees a transient environment that TR-001…TR-004 do not cover. Applies only to HV-connected converters
Typical stimulus / conditions: Standardised pulses injected on shielded HV supply lines through the specified HV artificial network; also measure transients generated by the device under test
Measure / record: Functional status, clamp voltage and current, device under test-generated transient amplitude and duration
Acceptance / target: Functional performance status per test plan; emitted transients within the vehicle-manufacturer limit
Equipment required: HV transient generator and HV artificial network per the technical specification; HV-rated probing; safety enclosure and interlocks
N6700 mapping with N6775A + N6791A: N6700 cannot supply or bias an HV DC link. Entirely external; normally a laboratory service
Main reference: ISO/TS 7637-4:2020 (confirmed 2024); applies only where HV-001/HV-002 apply

Purpose / failure mechanism: The matrix mandates measurement traceability for instruments but never verifies the transient generator itself. Two nominally compliant ISO 7637-2 generators can produce materially different pulses into the same load, so TR-001…TR-004 results are not comparable between laboratories without this step
Typical stimulus / conditions: Verify generator output waveform parameters into the specified verification load, before each campaign and after any service
Measure / record: Pulse amplitude, rise and fall time, duration, source impedance, repetition rate, burst structure; deviation from nominal
Acceptance / target: Generator parameters inside the tolerances of the verification method; verification date recorded with every TR-* result
Equipment required: Specified verification load and probing; wide-bandwidth oscilloscope and HV probe (oscilloscope already available)
N6700 mapping with N6775A + N6791A: N6700 has no role. The existing oscilloscope plus the specified verification load covers most of the work

Purpose / failure mechanism: Measure radio-frequency noise returned to vehicle supply
Typical stimulus / conditions: Operate device under test at representative modes/loads and measure with standardized network/receiver; voltage method (artificial network) and current-probe method
Measure / record: dBµV spectrum vs frequency
Acceptance / target: Below applicable CISPR 25/vehicle-manufacturer class limits
Equipment required: Keysight N6700 modular power system with N6775A source and N6791A electronic load; line-impedance-stabilization network or artificial network, electromagnetic-interference receiver/spectrum analyzer, chamber/table setup
N6700 mapping with N6775A + N6791A: N6700 may supply/load the device if its noise is below the measurement floor; formal testing still needs the CISPR 25 network and receiver.

Purpose / failure mechanism: Measure electromagnetic radiation from converter/harness
Typical stimulus / conditions: Representative operating modes and harness configuration
Measure / record: Electric-field spectrum
Acceptance / target: Below applicable CISPR 25/vehicle-manufacturer limits
Equipment required: Keysight N6700 modular power system with N6775A source and N6791A electronic load; absorber-lined shielded enclosure/semi-anechoic chamber, antennas, electromagnetic-interference receiver
N6700 mapping with N6775A + N6791A: N6700 may supply/load the device; formal radiated emissions require the chamber, antennas and receiver.

Purpose / failure mechanism: Verify immunity to radio-frequency current coupled into harness
Typical stimulus / conditions: Sweep radio-frequency current through harness using injection probe
Measure / record: Function, output voltage, communications, faults
Acceptance / target: Required functional status throughout sweep
Equipment required: Keysight N6700 modular power system with N6775A source and N6791A electronic load; radio-frequency signal generator, amplifier, injection/monitor probes, calibration fixture
N6700 mapping with N6775A + N6791A: N6700 supplies/loads only; bulk-current-injection immunity requires radio-frequency generation/amplification, probes and calibration fixture.

Purpose / failure mechanism: Verify immunity to continuous narrowband radio-frequency fields Cross-reference: EMC-011 is a recognized alternative method; results are not numerically interchangeable.
Typical stimulus / conditions: Expose device under test+harness in absorber-lined shielded enclosure
Measure / record: Function, output voltage, communications, faults
Acceptance / target: Required functional status
Equipment required: Keysight N6700 modular power system with N6775A source and N6791A electronic load; absorber-lined shielded enclosure chamber, radio-frequency signal generator/amplifiers/antennas/field probes
N6700 mapping with N6775A + N6791A: N6700 supplies/loads only; radiated immunity requires the absorber-lined enclosure, radio-frequency system, antennas and field monitoring.

Purpose / failure mechanism: Verify resistance to electrostatic discharge during assembly/service/occupant interaction
Typical stimulus / conditions: Contact/air discharges to defined points and coupling structures
Measure / record: Resets, damage, communication faults
Acceptance / target: Functional status per ISO/customer requirement
Equipment required: Keysight N6700 modular power system with N6775A source and N6791A electronic load; Automotive electrostatic-discharge simulator and ISO 10605 bench setup
N6700 mapping with N6775A + N6791A: N6700 powers/loads the device; electrostatic-discharge testing requires the ISO 10605 simulator and coupling/ground-plane setup.

Purpose / failure mechanism: Find dominant noise sources (switch node, switching frequency harmonics, spread-spectrum effectiveness) before paying for chamber time
Typical stimulus / conditions: Supply leads through a 5 µH artificial network into a spectrum analyzer; near-field magnetic-field/electric-field near-field probes over PCB and harness
Measure / record: dBµV spectrum vs target class limit; hotspot map
Acceptance / target: Project-defined pre-compliance margin to the target emissions limit; 6 decibels is a useful starting target but is not a CISPR 25 requirement
Equipment required: Keysight N6700 modular power system with N6775A source and N6791A electronic load; 5 µH artificial network/line-impedance-stabilization network, spectrum analyzer, near-field probe set
N6700 mapping with N6775A + N6791A: N6700 can power/load a pre-scan; add a 5-microhenry artificial network, spectrum analyzer and near-field probes, and verify source noise floor.
Main reference: CISPR 25:2021 methods used informally (not a compliant measurement)

Purpose / failure mechanism: Immunity to phones/radios used close to the module
Typical stimulus / conditions: Simulated portable-transmitter antennas near device under test and harness
Measure / record: Function, output voltage, resets, communication errors
Acceptance / target: Required functional status
Equipment required: Keysight N6700 modular power system with N6775A source and N6791A electronic load; ISO 11452-9 antennas, amplifiers, shielded enclosure
N6700 mapping with N6775A + N6791A: N6700 supplies/loads only; portable-transmitter immunity requires the ISO 11452-9 antenna/amplifier/shielded setup.

Purpose / failure mechanism: Immunity to low-frequency magnetic fields; relevant for current-sense and Hall-sensor based protection
Typical stimulus / conditions: Radiating loop or Helmholtz coil exposure
Measure / record: Function, current-sense accuracy, false trips
Acceptance / target: Required functional status
Equipment required: Keysight N6700 modular power system with N6775A source and N6791A electronic load; Radiating loop/Helmholtz coil, amplifier
N6700 mapping with N6775A + N6791A: N6700 supplies/loads only; magnetic-field immunity requires the specified loop/Helmholtz-coil system and amplifier.

Test: Conducted immunity, extended audio range (15 Hz – 250 kHz)
Purpose / failure mechanism: Per-lead narrowband conducted immunity on power and output leads. Overlaps AUTO-006 in frequency but is a different test with a different coupling arrangement, per-lead application and its own severity levels. A converter can pass one and fail the other
Typical stimulus / conditions: Narrowband voltage injected per lead through the specified isolation-transformer coupling, 15 Hz–250 kHz, at the customer-named severity level
Measure / record: Functional status, output-voltage disturbance, false resets, current-sense and protection false trips
Acceptance / target: Required functional status across the whole sweep on every applicable lead
Equipment required: Audio oscillator and power amplifier (source impedance ≤2 Ω, 50 W into 0,5 Ω); coupling isolation transformer rated for the DC lead current; voltage and current measurement
N6700 mapping with N6775A + N6791A: N6700 supplies and loads the device under test; injection needs the specified oscillator, amplifier and coupling transformer. The N6791A may need isolating from the injection point
Main reference: ISO 11452-10:2009 (confirmed 2020); the relationship to AUTO-006 is to be recorded explicitly, not assumed

Test: Electrical fast transient/burst and surge on charging and mains-coupled lines
Purpose / failure mechanism: Required for type approval of charging-coupled products. Neither test exists anywhere in ISO 7637 or CISPR 25, so a plan built only from ISO references omits them entirely
Typical stimulus / conditions: EFT/burst at approximately ±2 kV open circuit, 5 ns/50 ns, 5 kHz repetition, at least one minute; surge 1,2/50 µs at ±2 kV line-to-earth and ±1 kV line-to-line on AC lines and ±0,5 kV on DC lines, five applications at 0°, 90°, 180° and 270°
Measure / record: Functional status, resets, communication errors, damage, protection-component stress
Acceptance / target: Per the regulation and the customer test plan; exact levels from the applicable revision
Equipment required: EFT/burst generator; combination-wave surge generator; coupling and decoupling networks
N6700 mapping with N6775A + N6791A: N6700 can power the device under test if adequately decoupled, but must be protected from the injected transient. Generators and CDNs are external
Main reference: UN Regulation No. 10 Rev 7 Annexes 15 and 16 (in force 2025-06-17); applies only to charging-coupled or mains-coupled products

Purpose / failure mechanism: Recognised by UN R10 Rev 7 as an alternative to the absorber-lined shielded enclosure method of EMC-004. Often faster and cheaper for large harnesses, but the field statistics differ, so results are not numerically interchangeable with absorber-lined shielded enclosure
Typical stimulus / conditions: Expose device under test and harness in a mode-stirred reverberation chamber over the specified frequency range and severity
Measure / record: Functional status, output voltage, communications, faults; chamber calibration data
Acceptance / target: Required functional status; record which method was used, because absorber-lined shielded enclosure and reverberation results are not directly comparable
Equipment required: Reverberation chamber with mode stirrer; RF generation and amplification; field probes
N6700 mapping with N6775A + N6791A: N6700 supplies and loads only
Main reference: ISO 11452-11, recognised by UN R10 Rev 7; alternative to EMC-004

Test: Sub-200 MHz alternative immunity methods (TEM cell, stripline, DPI)
Purpose / failure mechanism: Below roughly 200 MHz, absorber-lined shielded enclosure antennas become large and inefficient and ISO 11452-2 itself points to other parts. Direct RF power injection in particular is the practical route to an IC-level immunity margin during design iteration rather than at qualification
Typical stimulus / conditions: Apply the selected method per its part of ISO 11452 at the customer-named severity level
Measure / record: Functional status; for DPI, forward power at failure per pin
Acceptance / target: Required functional status; for design iteration, record the margin rather than only pass/fail
Equipment required: TEM cell, stripline fixture, or DPI coupling network with RF generator, amplifier and directional coupler
N6700 mapping with N6775A + N6791A: N6700 supplies and loads only; the coupling fixture and RF chain are external
Main reference: ISO 11452-3 (TEM cell), ISO 11452-5 (stripline), ISO 11452-7 (DPI); ISO 11452-2 points below 200 MHz to parts 4, 3 and 5

Purpose / failure mechanism: Verify full-load operation at maximum ambient Cross-reference: For components inside an electric-propulsion system, ISO 19453-3/-4/-5 may govern instead of ISO 16750-3/-4/-5.
Typical stimulus / conditions: Soak chamber, operate at defined input voltage/load; include hot-start
Measure / record: output voltage, efficiency, component/case temperatures, faults
Acceptance / target: Meets function/derating limits; no thermal overstress
Equipment required: thermal chamber; Keysight N6700 modular power system with N6775A source and N6791A electronic load; thermocouples or temperature logger recommended
N6700 mapping with N6775A + N6791A: N6700 supplies/loads in the chamber; separate temperature sensors remain required.

Purpose / failure mechanism: Verify startup and regulation at minimum ambient Cross-reference: For components inside an electric-propulsion system, ISO 19453-3/-4/-5 may govern instead of ISO 16750-3/-4/-5.
Typical stimulus / conditions: Cold soak unpowered and/or powered, then start at low input voltage and rated load
Measure / record: Startup time, output voltage, inrush, oscillation
Acceptance / target: Starts and regulates per requirement
Equipment required: thermal chamber; Keysight N6700 modular power system with N6775A source and N6791A electronic load; thermocouples or temperature logger recommended
N6700 mapping with N6775A + N6791A: N6700 provides cold-start source/load; use external oscilloscope/current probe for startup/inrush and separate temperature sensors.

Purpose / failure mechanism: Determine output-current capability vs ambient/case temperature Cross-reference: For components inside an electric-propulsion system, ISO 19453-3/-4/-5 may govern instead of ISO 16750-3/-4/-5.
Typical stimulus / conditions: Sweep chamber temperature and load until rating/limit boundary
Measure / record: Max continuous load, junction temperature estimate, thermal shutdown margin
Acceptance / target: Defined derating curve with safe margin
Equipment required: thermal chamber; Keysight N6700 modular power system with N6775A source and N6791A electronic load; Thermocouples/infrared camera helpful
N6700 mapping with N6775A + N6791A: N6700 automates load/input sweeps versus chamber temperature within ratings; separate temperature sensing remains required.
Main reference: Product requirement; component limits (ISO 16750-4 defines operating temperature ranges, not a derating method)

Purpose / failure mechanism: Verify overtemperature protection threshold, hysteresis and safe recovery Cross-reference: For components inside an electric-propulsion system, ISO 19453-3/-4/-5 may govern instead of ISO 16750-3/-4/-5.
Typical stimulus / conditions: Force worst-case load/ambient until protection triggers, where safe
Measure / record: Shutdown temperature proxy, current, restart threshold
Acceptance / target: Controlled protection; no destructive cycling; restart/recovery behavior matches the technical safety concept and cannot exit a required latched safe state
Equipment required: thermal chamber; Keysight N6700 modular power system with N6775A source and N6791A electronic load; thermocouples or thermal camera recommended
N6700 mapping with N6775A + N6791A: N6700 supplies/loads while the chamber heats; use independent temperature sensing and safety limits.

Purpose / failure mechanism: Expose solder joints, connectors and materials to repeated temperature extremes Cross-reference: For components inside an electric-propulsion system, ISO 19453-3/-4/-5 may govern instead of ISO 16750-3/-4/-5.
Typical stimulus / conditions: Chamber cycles between specified minimum temperature/maximum temperature, powered or unpowered per plan
Measure / record: Functional checks, parameter drift, visual inspection
Acceptance / target: No crack/failure; parameters remain within limits
Present setup: Available if the thermal chamber supports the required profile
Equipment required: thermal chamber; Keysight N6700 modular power system with N6775A source and N6791A electronic load
N6700 mapping with N6775A + N6791A: N6700 provides powered cycling and electrical checks; chamber must meet the specified profile; stream data to the control computer.
Main reference: ISO 16750-4:2023 §5.3; LV 124 L-03 for life-based cycle count

Purpose / failure mechanism: Stress interfaces and solder joints with high ΔT rate Cross-reference: For components inside an electric-propulsion system, ISO 19453-3/-4/-5 may govern instead of ISO 16750-3/-4/-5.
Typical stimulus / conditions: Rapid transition between temperature extremes
Measure / record: Functional checks and post-test inspection
Acceptance / target: No damage or unacceptable drift
Equipment required: thermal chamber; Keysight N6700 modular power system with N6775A source and N6791A electronic load; Two-zone shock chamber may be required for specified transfer time
N6700 mapping with N6775A + N6791A: N6700 can support functional checks, but rapid thermal shock requires a two-zone/rapid-transfer system.

Purpose / failure mechanism: Find leakage, corrosion and insulation weaknesses Cross-reference: Unbiased humidity does not reproduce electrochemical migration; see LIFE-007. Cross-reference: For components inside an electric-propulsion system, ISO 19453-3/-4/-5 may govern instead of ISO 16750-3/-4/-5.
Typical stimulus / conditions: High humidity with temperature profile as specified
Measure / record: Leakage/current, insulation behavior, function
Acceptance / target: Meets functional/insulation requirements
Equipment required: thermal chamber; Keysight N6700 modular power system with N6775A source and N6791A electronic load; Humidity-controlled chamber required unless present chamber supports RH
N6700 mapping with N6775A + N6791A: N6700 can power/monitor; humidity testing needs a humidity-controlled chamber and, where specified, insulation measurement.

Purpose / failure mechanism: Catch interactions missed by separate electrical/thermal tests Cross-reference: For components inside an electric-propulsion system, ISO 19453-3/-4/-5 may govern instead of ISO 16750-3/-4/-5.
Typical stimulus / conditions: Repeat line/load/start/overload tests at minimum temperature, room and maximum temperature
Measure / record: All electrical metrics and temperatures
Acceptance / target: Same functional-status requirement with allowed temperature derating
Equipment required: thermal chamber; Keysight N6700 modular power system with N6775A source and N6791A electronic load; control computer for automated test control and continuous electrical logging
N6700 mapping with N6775A + N6791A: N6700 is well suited to repeated electrical characterization at temperature corners; use the oscilloscope for fast events.

Purpose / failure mechanism: Find malfunctions that appear only in a narrow temperature window (oscillator, comparator and threshold drift) Cross-reference: For components inside an electric-propulsion system, ISO 19453-3/-4/-5 may govern instead of ISO 16750-3/-4/-5.
Typical stimulus / conditions: Step across the operating range in small increments with a functional check at each step
Measure / record: output voltage, switching frequency, thresholds, faults at each step
Acceptance / target: Function per requirement at every step
Equipment required: thermal chamber; Keysight N6700 modular power system with N6775A source and N6791A electronic load
N6700 mapping with N6775A + N6791A: N6700 can automate the electrical check at each chamber temperature step and stream measurements.

Purpose / failure mechanism: Moisture condensing on the PCB causes leakage in high-impedance feedback/sense nodes and electrochemical migration Cross-reference: Unbiased humidity does not reproduce electrochemical migration; see LIFE-007. Cross-reference: For components inside an electric-propulsion system, ISO 19453-3/-4/-5 may govern instead of ISO 16750-3/-4/-5.
Typical stimulus / conditions: Condensation profile with the device under test powered as specified
Measure / record: Leakage current, output voltage accuracy, faults, post-test inspection for migration
Acceptance / target: No malfunction; no electrochemical migration
Equipment required: thermal chamber; Keysight N6700 modular power system with N6775A source and N6791A electronic load; Humidity chamber with condensation control
N6700 mapping with N6775A + N6791A: N6700 can power/monitor; controlled condensation requires a suitable humidity/condensation chamber if the existing chamber cannot create the profile.

Purpose / failure mechanism: Exterior, under-hood and underbody locations add corrosion, splash and solar loads Cross-reference: For components inside an electric-propulsion system, ISO 19453-3/-4/-5 may govern instead of ISO 16750-3/-4/-5.
Typical stimulus / conditions: Select per mounting location: salt spray, ice-water shock, solar radiation, mixed flowing gas
Measure / record: Corrosion, cracking, function, insulation
Acceptance / target: No unacceptable degradation
Equipment required: thermal chamber; Keysight N6700 modular power system with N6775A source and N6791A electronic load; Salt-spray, splash/immersion, solar and gas chambers
N6700 mapping with N6775A + N6791A: N6700 is only for functional powering/monitoring; location-specific environmental stresses require dedicated facilities.

Purpose / failure mechanism: Accelerate thermally driven wear-out under electrical load
Typical stimulus / conditions: Extended powered operation at agreed elevated temperature/load
Measure / record: Drift, failures, efficiency, temperatures
Acceptance / target: No failure; drift within DV limits
Equipment required: Keysight N6700 modular power system with N6775A source and N6791A electronic load; thermal chamber; temperature sensors; control computer for continuous logging; Automated logging; independent safety cutoffs
N6700 mapping with N6775A + N6791A: N6700 provides long-duration electrical stress; stream data continuously and use independent safety cutoffs.
Main reference: LV 124 L-02 (duration derived from the mission temperature profile); vehicle-manufacturer DV/PV plan

Purpose / failure mechanism: Stress power semiconductors, solder and magnetics through repeated ΔTj Cross-reference: For power-module-based stages, LIFE-006 replaces ambient cycling with junction-temperature-swing cycling.
Typical stimulus / conditions: Alternate high/low load and/or power state at temperature corners
Measure / record: output voltage, transistor on-resistance and loss proxies, temperature swing, failures
Acceptance / target: No degradation beyond limits
Equipment required: Keysight N6700 modular power system with N6775A source and N6791A electronic load; thermal chamber; temperature sensors; control computer for continuous logging; Current/temperature logging
N6700 mapping with N6775A + N6791A: N6700 automates power/load cycling while the chamber controls ambient temperature; use separate temperature sensing and safety cutoffs.

Purpose / failure mechanism: Verify no cumulative thermal runaway
Typical stimulus / conditions: Max permitted input voltage/load at worst thermal point for extended duration
Measure / record: Temperatures, output voltage, efficiency, fault events
Acceptance / target: Stable temperatures and parameters
Equipment required: Keysight N6700 modular power system with N6775A source and N6791A electronic load; thermal chamber; temperature sensors; control computer for continuous logging
N6700 mapping with N6775A + N6791A: N6700 holds worst-case input/load within module ratings and logs continuously; external temperature sensing remains required.

Purpose / failure mechanism: Electrolytic/polymer capacitor wear-out often limits converter life
Typical stimulus / conditions: Measure ripple current and case/hot-spot temperature over the mission profile
Measure / record: Ripple current, temperature rise, calculated lifetime
Acceptance / target: Calculated life above required vehicle life with margin
Equipment required: Keysight N6700 modular power system with N6775A source and N6791A electronic load; thermal chamber; temperature sensors; control computer for continuous logging; Current probe, thermocouples
N6700 mapping with N6775A + N6791A: N6700 establishes operating points; capacitor-life verification still needs ripple-current and hot-spot-temperature measurement.
Main reference: Capacitor manufacturer lifetime model; mission profile (e.g. LV 124 temperature collective)

Purpose / failure mechanism: Determine robustness margin between specified operating limits, functional failure and destructive failure on sacrificial samples Cross-reference: RV-001 provides the mission profile and failure-mechanism matrix required to interpret this margin test.
Typical stimulus / conditions: Increase temperature, input voltage, load and, where applicable, vibration in controlled steps beyond specification until functional failure; continue to destructive limit only when the safety plan permits
Measure / record: Applied stress, functional-limit point, destruct-limit point, failure mode and post-failure inspection
Acceptance / target: Margins meet the project robustness target and observed failure modes are fed back into the failure-mode-effects-and-diagnostic analysis and dependent-failure analysis
Equipment required: Keysight N6700 modular power system with N6775A source and N6791A electronic load; thermal chamber; digital oscilloscope; independent safety cutoffs; higher-range source/load or vibration equipment when required; sacrificial samples
N6700 mapping with N6775A + N6791A: N6700 can perform controlled electrical step stress only inside its 60-volt/5-ampere/300-watt source and 60-volt/20-ampere/100-watt load limits; testing beyond those limits requires dedicated equipment.
Main reference: ISO 26262-5:2018 over-limit testing; product robustness plan; see iso26262-asil-test-mapping.md LIFE-005

Purpose / failure mechanism: Where a power stage uses a power module, bond-wire and solder fatigue are driven by junction-temperature swing, not ambient. TH-005 and LIFE-002 cycle the ambient and do not reproduce ΔTj. Results verify the manufacturer's lifetime model against the mission profile
Typical stimulus / conditions: PCsec and PCmin power cycling to the defined ΔTj with the end-of-life criteria defined for the module technology; extend with high/low-temperature storage and HTRB/HTGB/H3TRB as applicable. For SiC add dynamic gate stress, dynamic reverse bias and dynamic H3TRB
Measure / record: Cycles to first end-of-life criterion; Vce(on) or Rds(on) drift; thermal-resistance drift; bond and solder condition
Acceptance / target: Cycles to failure consistent with the mission profile and the manufacturer lifetime model, with the required margin
Equipment required: Power-cycling test system with junction-temperature determination; module-level fixturing
N6700 mapping with N6775A + N6791A: N6700 cannot perform module power cycling. Dedicated equipment is required; usually a laboratory service
Main reference: ECPE Guideline AQG 324 Rel. 04.1/2025 (based on LV 324); applies only to power-module-based stages

Test: Biased humidity (H3TRB / THB) and electrochemical migration
Purpose / failure mechanism: TH-007 and TH-010 apply humidity without electrical bias. Electrochemical migration and dendrite growth need moisture **plus** a potential gradient, so an unbiased humidity test can pass a board that fails in service
Typical stimulus / conditions: Apply the specified temperature and humidity with the device under test electrically biased for the required duration; include high-impedance feedback and sense nodes in the biased set
Measure / record: Leakage current over time; insulation resistance; parametric drift; post-test inspection for migration and corrosion
Acceptance / target: No migration or corrosion; leakage and parametric drift inside limits; post-test function per requirement
Equipment required: Temperature/humidity chamber with bias feed-throughs; leakage-current monitoring. The existing thermal chamber is insufficient unless humidity-capable
N6700 mapping with N6775A + N6791A: N6700 can supply the bias if the chamber has suitable feed-throughs and the campaign is long-running; leakage monitoring needs a low-current instrument
Main reference: ECPE AQG 324 H3TRB; AEC-Q101 and AEC-Q200 biased-humidity tests; extends TH-007 and TH-010

Purpose / failure mechanism: Find fatigue/intermittent connections Cross-reference: For components inside an electric-propulsion system, ISO 19453-3/-4/-5 may govern instead of ISO 16750-3/-4/-5.
Typical stimulus / conditions: Vehicle-location-specific vibration profile
Measure / record: Function during test; post-test inspection
Acceptance / target: No loss of function or damage
Equipment required: functional electrical test bench based on N6700; Electrodynamic shaker, fixture, control accelerometers
N6700 mapping with N6775A + N6791A: N6700 can power/load and log during vibration; shaker, fixture and accelerometers are additional.

Purpose / failure mechanism: Verify robustness to road/handling shocks Cross-reference: For components inside an electric-propulsion system, ISO 19453-3/-4/-5 may govern instead of ISO 16750-3/-4/-5.
Typical stimulus / conditions: Specified shock pulses and axes
Measure / record: Functional interruptions; mechanical damage
Acceptance / target: Meets location-specific requirement
Equipment required: functional electrical test bench based on N6700; Shock table/shaker
N6700 mapping with N6775A + N6791A: N6700 can power/load and monitor during shock when permitted; shock equipment, fixture and accelerometers are additional.

Purpose / failure mechanism: Verify enclosure protection where applicable Cross-reference: For components inside an electric-propulsion system, ISO 19453-3/-4/-5 may govern instead of ISO 16750-3/-4/-5.
Typical stimulus / conditions: IP-code test appropriate to mounting location
Measure / record: Water/dust ingress; function/insulation
Acceptance / target: Required IP code
Equipment required: functional electrical test bench based on N6700; IP test equipment
N6700 mapping with N6775A + N6791A: N6700 is for functional checks only; dedicated ingress equipment and insulation measurement are required.

Purpose / failure mechanism: Check plastics, seals, coatings and labels against fluids Cross-reference: For components inside an electric-propulsion system, ISO 19453-3/-4/-5 may govern instead of ISO 16750-3/-4/-5.
Typical stimulus / conditions: Apply location-relevant agents, then condition and inspect/test
Measure / record: Visual/material change, electrical function
Acceptance / target: No unacceptable degradation
Equipment required: functional electrical test bench based on N6700; Chemical test facilities
